links.outcome: Accuracy and errors against 2025 IAP/APA guidelines; hallucination and fatal error rates
links.effect: Response-level hallucination rates were 25.9% (ChatGPT) vs 22.2% (Gemini); one fatal error (premature necrosectomy) in Gemini (3.7%); accuracy comparable (P = .217).
links.quote: One fatal error (advocating premature necrosectomy) occurred in the Gemini cohort (3.7%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, safety, and readability of two search-augmented LLMs on 27 acute pancreatitis scenarios evaluated by surgeons, but does not test or compare an implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
